profile.headline: Software Developer at TDIndustries, Inc.
profile.summary: Results-driven, customer-focused, articulate and analytical IT Systems Administrator with several years of experience. Strong in design and integration problem solving skills. Skilled in developing business plans, requirements specifications, user documentation, and architectural systems research. Strong written and verbal communications. Interested in a challenging technical track career in System Administration. Outstanding ability to define and implement system changes, process and procedures updates. Work with vendors and evaluate technical systems, budgeting and licensing. Strong project management and organizational skills.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
TD Industries
IT Support Specialist
02-2016 to Current

•	Responsible for direct support to Houston main office, executives, senior managers and external employees.
•	Provide hardware upgrade path reports for laptops and iOS devices. 
•	Managed hardware and software inventory for the Houston location. Provided asset
reports to senior business unit managers.
•	Rolled out several successful solutions with vendors for the newly built location. Solutions include: A/V for all meeting rooms, Microphone solution, Digital Signage and met set deadlines. Followed up with punch list items to finalize and resolve all issues.
•	Implemented onboarding documentation and created workflow for new hire account creation, hardware, and software requests.
•	Implemented digital signage for four different business units with remote administration for employees.
•	Microsoft Intune MDM rollout.
•	Microsoft Windows 7 to Windows 10 migration.
•	Met company SLA’s and documented ticket resolutions using Microsoft ticketing system.
•	Manage Datavox security systems, roles, and badging system.
•	Local support for 200+ employees via phone, e-mail and remote connection.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
• Gathered business workflows and provided software/hardware implementation to increase productivity.
• Provide software solutions for business growth while adding efficiency to current workflows.
• Gathered business requirements, documents and workflows for JDE ERP implementation.
• Virtual Server Management using Hyper-V.
• Server Rack setup and switch configuration.
• SQL server and script/report support.
• Sharepoint Support.
• Lync Server 2010 - 2013, Webapps and SQL Server implementation and support.
• Microsoft Exchange server support.
• Active Directory Management and support.

positions.title: Field Service Tech/Desktop Support
positions.description:
• Provided computer technical support for Amegy Bank of Texas Corporate Office
• Worked directly and provided offsite support to Amegy’s Executives.
• Imaged, configured and deployed workstation for virtual (Xenapp/Citrix) and non-virtual employees in Windows XP/Windows 7 environment.
• Worked with Reuters, Deutsche Bank and Bloomberg to troubleshoot software and hardware issues for our Foreign Exchange group.
• Setup and resolved VOIP phone issues.
• Support of server, switch, patch panel issues and worked with Network Operations to resolve high priority network problems.
• Used Active Directory for employee account management
• Setup network printers in Windows Server 2008
• Tracked tickets using the Remedy system for auditing and metrics
• Setup and created profiles for Blackberries on the Blackberry Exchange Server as well as iPhone setup using Airwatch for corporate e-mail.
• Desktop Remote assistance

positions.title: IT Support Specialist III
positions.description:
• Provide computer technical support to 6 bank affiliates/satellite offices through phone, chat, remote tool and e-mail.
• Provide Level III support to our Level I employees as well as train new employees.
• Provided feedback in Targeted Selection interview process for potential employees.
• Monitor call/chat volume and move our employees to high volume drivers as needed.
• Customer software configuration: Active Directory, Blackberry Exchange Server,  Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft Office, Safeboot and other bank proprietary software.
• Customer hardware configuration and troubleshooting.
• Use of Remedy ticketing system for documentation as well as modifying and making new templates.
• On Disaster Recovery team and Priority 1 On-call team.

positions.title: Training Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provided computer technical support to employees and library patrons
•	Installing and resolving PC hardware and software problems
•	Resolved networking and networked printer problems
•	Resolved laptop hardware and software problem
•	Resolved library’s Wi-Fi network and hardware problems
•	Kept documentation on all PC hardware/software related problems for administration offices
•	Started Game Time program for surrounding area teens
•	Acquired game systems to provide competitive network play with other system libraries
•	Hosted and prepared several tournaments for Game Time at the library

positions.title: Components Associate
positions.description:
•	Helped maintain and organize CPU, Memory and Hard Drive inventory
•	Helped customers with different PC component questions and provided information on different aspects of PC builds
•	Trained new employees on PC basics, inventory system software and store policies
•	Gained experience using point of sales system and finalizing a transaction on POS

positions.title: Help Desk
positions.description:
•	Provided technical support for all 200 Southwest Kroger stores and main office
•	Worked with Novell, Windows 3.11 and Windows 95/NT for sending remote updates, remote Windows installation and configuration
•	Helped repair and maintain PC’s, printers, network and backup tape systems

projects.title: Windows 7 Migration
projects.description: Lead the effort to migrate 3000+ machines from several campus locations and 80+ Branch Locations from Windows XP to Windows 7 Within 1 Year.  Migration took place in San Antonio, Dallas, and Houston Location.  My duties comprises of battle plan tactics, ordering, monitoring and controlling, asset management and scheduling.  Project was completed on time and on within budget.
